listing.name: Aliceworks Hull Mods
listing.summary: Adds a collection of experimental hull mods that modify base stats, armor, drive performance, and cargo capacity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of experimental hull mods that modify base stats, armor, drive performance, and cargo capacity.

description: Adds several new hull mods including armored bulkheads, shield stripping refits, experimental drive fields, and cargo modifications. These mods are designed for specific ship types and often come with significant trade-offs or incompatibilities with other hull mods. The author notes they are new to modding and Java, so balance may change.
